headline: AutoViewMem organizes long-term conversational memory into learned semantic views
summary: The September 2026 AutoViewMem preprint proposes learning low-overlap semantic views from conversational traces and using them to structure memory at write time, followed by offline consolidation and ordinary top-K retrieval. The authors report improved long-horizon question answering and personalization over memory baselines on LoCoMo and PersonaMem with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B.
